_: Provenance of oracle_kimilinear_16tok.bin. tools/kimi_ref.py computes its logits FROM a WASTE container, so this fixture is only comparable against a container quantized the way this one was. tests/run.sh reads `trunk` below and skips, with the reason, when the container under test does not match — a cross-width diff looks exactly like an engine bug and is not one.
converted_on: macOS arm64, --device mps (the default where MPS is available)
logits: the last position after prefill, f32, vocab 163840
command: uv run --no-project --with torch --with fla-core --with einops python tools/kimi_ref.py --container MODEL --prompt-ids IDS --tokens 0 --dump tests/fixtures/oracle_kimilinear_16tok.bin
history: The previous fixture came from a --trunk8 container and nothing recorded it, so anyone converting with today's defaults saw a 3.28 max diff and no way to tell engine from fixture (issue #7). It was not an engine error: a fresh oracle diverged from that fixture by exactly the amount the engine did.
